result.rationale: Both responses correctly preserve the Quartz Auditor role as the exclusive authorization boundary, use MAY exactly once as permission, include the 403 for authenticated principals without the role, and retain all required tokens. The only difference is formatting: A merges the two authorization sentences with a semicolon, B keeps them as separate sentences. Both are faithful, natural phrasings within the accepted criteria. Neither weakens the authorization condition or conflates authentication with authorization. No material advantage either way.
